description: A target user has a session on this computer; credentials or tokens can be harvested if you control the box.

telemetry.detail: ProcessAccess against lsass.exe if credentials are dumped from memory (mimikatz) - very high fidelity.
Token theft / impersonation (steal_token) is low-signal; LSASS dumping is high-signal. Score assumes the quieter token path.

prerequisite_privilege: Local admin / SYSTEM on the session host (usually via AdminTo)
abuse_primitive: Impersonate the session's token (quiet), or dump LSASS for the credential (loud, Sysmon 10).
notes: Score reflects token theft. If the only viable harvest is an LSASS dump, treat as 65+ (Sysmon 10 is a high-fidelity alert).
